# Playtest diary: r16b-engineer-full

- **Mode:** typed
- **Start:** the start of the game
- **Persona:** a systems engineer who wants to understand how things work before using them, tests one variable at a time, keeps notes on cause and effect and saves before every experiment
- **Model:** claude-opus-5-5
- **Seed:** 48114
- **Conveniences:** on
- **Undo:** off
- **Build commit:** 70c66c14
- **Budget:** about 400 commands per leg, 1500 commands in all
- **Round:** 16b
- **Friction log:** filed through the harness (--friction), in playtests/2026-10-12/r16b-engineer-full.friction.jsonl

## Narrative

Activation form refused until both seats taken; sat in pilot seat, Floyd took copilot. Form in slot -> "Type in the course heading". Chronometer read 5693; at 5700 typed 184 (5700-5749 row) -> course set, flew, docked at bay two of station, +5. Hunger/thirst warning on arrival -> ate orange goo (apricot yogurt). Spacetruck: SB radio damaged (microphone missing), nothing else. HUNGER escalating: "really ravenous and your lips are quite parched" (cmd 823), "starting to feel faint from lack of food and liquid" (cmd 847). Airlock test: closed upper door, no open containers, saved (#759 Airlock), opened lower door -> lungs rupture, died again; restored. So vacuum kills regardless of containers. Took 20-prong board from Trading Post (welder #1 there). "ask for frezone" -> no one here. Junk Yard: only the boots.

"If you don't eat or drink something in a few millichrons, you'll probably pass out." (857). Cmd 862: "You collapse from extreme thirst and hunger." DIED of starvation, ~63 commands after the first day-3 hunger warning. All three saves are after the taffy, so the starvation clock is running in every save. Plan: use the PX save (~75 turns of life left) as a reconnaissance run (elevator shaft / L8, Frezone), then start over from the opening with an efficient route and a food budget.
- Cmds 863-878 (reconnaissance from doomed saves): Restored PX #711. Elevator at L5: "The elevator shaft is supposed to be a weightless environment... But the gravity in the shaft is one standard Gee!" Typed 8 -> "the elevator begins plunging down the shaft in a power dive!" -> DEATH. So the elevator is a trap; never use it on day 3. Restored Airlock #759: from Warehouse "open lower door" -> "You can't see any lower door here!"; "hold breath" not understood. Conclusion: no way into vacuum found; a robot (Floyd early, before he turns) is my best theory. DECISION: every save is past the last food, so the game cannot be won from any save. Warehouse: saved; "floyd, go down" -> "You know Floyd and his sense of direction"; "floyd, get the frezone" -> can't see any. Plato: "ask about X" -> will look in library (generic). Pawn Shop spray can; Shady Dan's rank 10; Trading Post NW = Pet Store: ceiling panel nip (+3, 17); Broadway SE Barbershop: break mirror, foil (+4, 21); Grocery: bag of taffy. Opened cage, lured balloon with spores TP -> Greasy Straw -> Main St -> Grimy -> S Conn -> S Junction -> L5 -> L4 -> L3 -> Chapel (10 puffs; can now "light"). Flame off (pulpit switch), saved Chapel, took leash -> lifted, open star, take hyperdiode fumbled (too many things) but fell to floor; dropped leash, picked up (+7, 28); swapped into detonator. TIREDNESS at 8132 day 1.

"ask plato about frezone" while reading -> "Please let me read in peace!". "search cubicles" -> personal items only. Armory: "put ID card in reader" -> door opens (+5, 36), zapgun. Form+bedistor packed in uniform. Loan Shark: "shoot box with zapgun" -> coin (+5, 41). Hunger at 2053 day 2 -> ate gray goo. Ostrich followed the nip from Doc's to the PX; coin, type 6, klunk, put nip in hole -> timer (+6, 47). Saved PX (move ~?, time 2294). Run 2 is now ~1 day ahead of run 1 at the same score. Plato: "Tagging along after this simpleton human is becoming tiresome." PLATO AMBUSH in Mess Hall at ~2684 DAY 2 (run 1 it was day 3 on L6). I just waited 4 turns: this time Floyd "burst into tears and dashes out of the room" -> DIED. Run 1 Floyd knocked the gun away. Difference unknown (Floyd affection? something I said?). Restored PX (2294).

Unclear whether talking matters or it is random. Took all back; saved South Junction (time 2712, score 54) - now ~a full day ahead of run 1.

No suit anywhere. New theory: trap Floyd alone in the airlock (he follows a turn late), close the upper door, and order him to open the lower door and fetch the Frezone.

Let's play Hider-and-Seeker." Played: I won, Floyd kicked my shin (turning nasty). "ask floyd about frezone" -> "Beats me." Missionary: nothing. In the airlock, "drill hole in lower door" -> "The point of the drill doesn't seem to be as hard as the outer door." Plastic bag closed; Thermos opened (blue soup inside - left OPEN, close it). friction.why: Lovely emergent alternative to the ostrich-nip solution; felt clever and funny, and it rewarded defending myself rather than punishing it
